title: House in the jungle heavily protected by armed men.
content: I’ve had a lot of MW dreams lately where my son is either taken by people or people are trying to take him. It only happens when they are children. My other sons who are adults now are never there with me anymore, almost like they aged out. This was the last time where I wasn’t able to immediately get him back so I followed them secretly. They took him from the waterfront beach restaurant and I saw it happen so I followed to try to steal him back. They had at least ten children in a single file line, walked them all here through a desert area on a dirt road. The desert eventually turned into jungle. The house was like a compound surrounded by thick concrete wall areas with multiple sections of enclosed concrete squares. Someone set off a mortar in the jungle distracting the guards and I slipped in through a dog door type hole on the side of the house, not sure what it was for but I think package delivery. When I got inside the kids were all kept locked in one room with a square hole in the ceiling. The house was multiple levels. Has anyone else been experiencing their kids getting take or trying to be taken?
